title: Configuration Surface
description: The engine's declarative configuration shape for 3 tiers.
body: One Schematic engine, configured 3 ways (PRD §17 Wave 3) — this file is the whole interface Wave 5 programs against when it builds the Stack, Service and Module Schematics. Nothing below draws; every value here is read by `engine.ts`, `rules.ts`, `routing.ts` or `frame.ts`. The shape is deliberately declarative: an edge kind is a row in a table rather than a callback, so a refusal can name the rule it came from and a test can enumerate what a tier accepts without running a drag.
